package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	pb "example.com/proto/report"
	grpc "google.golang.org/grpc"
)

type reportServer struct {
	pb.UnimplementedReportServiceServer
}

// scenario for grpc_large_message_without_streaming: unary RPC handlers returning messages > 4MB (inferred from large slice/struct serialization patterns)
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func scenario412Positive() *grpc.Server {
	srv := grpc.NewServer()
	pb.RegisterReportServiceServer(srv, &reportServer{})
	return srv
}

func (s *reportServer) GenerateReport(ctx context.Context, req *pb.ReportRequest) (*pb.ReportResponse, error) {
	items := make([]*pb.ReportItem, 100000)
	for i := 0; i < 100000; i++ {
		items[i] = &pb.ReportItem{
			Id:    int64(i),
			Title: "Large report item with substantial descriptive text content for each entry",
			Data:  make([]byte, 100),
		}
	}
	return &pb.ReportResponse{Items: items}, nil
}
